meta.title: Củng cố – Tiếng Anh 10 · Unit 1: Family life
meta.subtitle: Trường THPT Vĩnh Thạnh – Tổ Tiếng Anh (bản demo) · NLS 5.2.NC1b; 2.5.NC1a

parts.title: PHẦN I. Câu trắc nghiệm nhiều phương án lựa chọn

questions.content: Choose the word that matches the meaning: “someone who earns money to support their family”.
questions.expl: Vocabulary 1 (tr.10): breadwinner – người trụ cột kiếm tiền nuôi gia đình.

questions.content: Choose the word that matches the meaning: “a person who manages a home and often raises children instead of earning money”.

options.t: picking up and carrying heavy objects
food and other goods sold at a shop
work around the house such as cooking and cleaning

questions.expl: Vocabulary 1: heavy lifting – việc khuân vác nặng.

questions.content: Which word begins with the consonant blend /kr/?
questions.expl: Pronunciation (tr.9): /kr/ – crash, crane, cream; /br/ – breadwinner, breakfast, brown; /tr/ – track, tree, train.

questions.content: Mrs Lan usually ______ the cooking in her family.
questions.expl: “usually” diễn tả thói quen → thì hiện tại đơn, chủ ngữ ngôi thứ ba số ít: does.

questions.content: I’m afraid he can’t answer the phone now. He ______ the rubbish.
questions.expl: Hành động đang diễn ra tại thời điểm nói (now) → hiện tại tiếp diễn: is putting out.

questions.content: My sister can’t do any housework today. She ______ for her exams.
questions.expl: Việc đang diễn ra quanh thời điểm nói (today) → hiện tại tiếp diễn: is studying.

options.t: I am knowing the answer to this question.
She is wanting a new laptop now.
I know the answer to this question.

questions.expl: Remember! (tr.10): không dùng thì tiếp diễn với động từ chỉ trạng thái (like, love, need, want, know, agree...).

questions.content: In the reading text “Benefits of doing housework”, the word “gratitude” means
According to the reading text, why should parents encourage their kids to share the housework?

options.t: It teaches them life skills and helps build their character.
It gives parents more time to go out.
It helps children get higher marks at school immediately.
It stops children from playing sports.

questions.expl: Câu kết bài đọc: “It teaches them life skills and helps build their character. Therefore, parents should encourage their kids to share the housework...”

parts.title: PHẦN II. Câu trắc nghiệm đúng sai

questions.content: Read the text “Benefits of doing housework” (Tiếng Anh 10, tr.11) and decide whether each statement is true or false.

statements.text: Most people think that housework is boring and is the responsibility of wives and mothers only.
statements.expl: Câu mở đầu bài đọc nói đúng như vậy.

statements.text: Kids who do housework develop important life skills that they will need for the rest of their lives.
Schools can fully teach children all the life skills they need, so learning them at home is not important.
statements.expl: Bài đọc: “These are the things that schools cannot fully teach, so it’s important for children to learn them at home.”

statements.text: Doing chores together helps strengthen family bonds and creates special moments between children and parents.
statements.expl: Đoạn 3: “doing chores together helps strengthen family bonds, creating special moments between children and parents.”
